items.description:
RubyStone Boutique Hotel blends a classic suburban residential feel with a cool, urban style in the quiet suburb of Fauna Park, Polokwane. Its website describes it as a relaxed place to unwind, with easy access to the major shopping malls and other amenities.

The hotel offers Wi-Fi hotspots, air conditioning, car parking, conference facilities and a restaurant and bar. RubyStone's own in-house restaurant, Ruby Steakhouse, serves the guests, and the staff say they can cater for business travellers, special occasions and holidays alike. The website's gallery shows the foyer, boardroom and bedrooms, and rooms are presented as a home away from home. It is in Bekker Street, Fauna Park.

items.description:
The Leopard Tree is an owner-run bed and breakfast guest house in the Sterpark suburb of Polokwane, with four en-suite bedrooms that each comfortably sleep two to three guests. Guests have the use of a communal lounge as well as an upstairs pajama lounge, and breakfast is served in the dining room each morning.

Current booking listings for the property confirm free Wi-Fi, DSTV, communal braai facilities and a swimming pool, with the guest house able to accommodate up to ten people at a time and consistently strong guest ratings. It is a comfortable stopover for leisure travellers and business visitors passing through Polokwane, with easy access to the surrounding Sterpark area.

TlouTlou Cleaning & Pest Control is a pest control, cleaning and hygiene company offering a wide range of pest treatments, including cockroach, rodent, ant, mosquito, fly, termite, wasp, flea, bed-bug and weevil control. Alongside pest eradication, the business provides lawn maintenance, weed control, general cleaning, hygiene services and honey-sucker services for blocked drains and sewage removal.

Established in 2006 and describing itself as 100% black-owned, the company has grown to operate across all nine provinces of South Africa, serving both commercial and domestic customers who need a single provider for pest, cleaning and hygiene needs. Its head office is in Zone 6, Seshego, Polokwane.

Vision Works Platinum Park is an optometry practice trading as MSS Optical Inc, offering eye examinations and helping patients choose eyewear suited to their needs, along with a range of designer sunglasses. The practice forms part of the wider Vision Works group operating in Polokwane.

Appointments are available for children and adults alike, including anyone due for a routine eye examination, and the practice is based at Shop 8 inside Dis-Chem at Platinum Park Shopping Centre in Bendor Park. It is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm and on Saturdays from 9am to 1pm, making it a convenient stop for eye care and eyewear while shopping at the centre.

items.description:
All Seasons Function Hire rents marquee tents and waterproof stretch tents for events in Futura, Polokwane. The company describes its marquees as suitable for events of all sizes and types, providing space for guests, exhibitors and vendors.

Its services include ablution facilities so guests have clean restrooms, and a trained team that goes to the event site to set up the marquee, arrange chairs, tables and stages, and dismantle and remove everything afterwards. The business is an affiliate of Vyna Tarp, a PVC and canvas tarpaulin manufacturer, and it invites customers to inspect the products in Polokwane. The company says it aims to offer the best quality products and services to its clients.

items.description:
Atrium Boutique Hotel traces its origins to a hospitality project launched by the Mukwevho Group in 2015, and has since grown into a boutique hotel offering modern rooms and suites that combine contemporary amenities with comfortable furnishings in a serene setting.

Guests are looked after with personalised service and concierge assistance throughout their stay, whether they are visiting Polokwane for business or leisure. The hotel is on Burger Street in Polokwane, and its blend of attentive hospitality and considered interiors makes it a fitting choice for travellers who want a more personal alternative to a standard hotel stay in the city.

Bosveld Communications is a Polokwane-based internet service provider that supplies fixed-wireless, satellite and fibre internet to homes, businesses and remote farming areas across Limpopo. It sells uncapped, unshaped and unthrottled connectivity, and its website lists fibre, Wi-Fi sign-up and portal login for existing customers.

The company also provides per-second VoIP calling, CCTV surveillance systems, computer, laptop and server sales, support and service, and custom wired and wireless network set-up. Its VoIP is billed per second at what the company describes as the best rates. An independent directory describes it as running its own registered network rather than simply reselling connections. Its head office is in Polokwane, and it serves customers across Limpopo.

Cathedral of the Sacred Heart is a Roman Catholic cathedral and parish church on Biccard Street in Polokwane, serving as the cathedral church of the Diocese of Polokwane and the seat of its bishop. Construction of the building began in 1895 and was completed in 1897, making it one of the earliest churches established in what was then known as Pietersburg.

The cathedral continues to serve as a place of Catholic worship for parishioners in Polokwane and for the wider Catholic community across the Diocese, hosting Mass and other services for the congregation that gathers there. Its long history gives it a central place among the Diocese's parishes, and it remains an active place of worship in the heart of Polokwane.

Danlee Overnight Accommodation is a guest house in Polokwane offering private rooms, including family rooms, each with air conditioning, a television and a work desk. The property has garden areas with outdoor seating and barbecue facilities, free Wi-Fi throughout, private parking and breakfast included in every stay.

Current accommodation listings rate the 3-star guest house at 8.8 out of 10 based on 49 reviews, reflecting consistent guest satisfaction with the rooms and service on offer. It suits leisure travellers, families and anyone needing a comfortable overnight stop in Polokwane, and is located in the Capricorn area of the city.

Shop 03 at The Greenery shopping centre on Oost Street is home to this branch of Debonairs Pizza, the South African pizza chain known for its Triple-Decker and Real Deal ranges. The branch offers dine-in and counter service alongside collection and delivery, making it suited to a quick meal on the way home or a sit-down order with the family.

Catering options and family-friendly combos round out the menu, aimed at individuals, families and groups wanting a casual pizza meal without booking ahead. The branch trades Monday to Thursday from 9am to 8pm, Friday and Saturday from 9am to 9pm, and Sunday from 10am to 8pm.

items.description:
The firm is a Polokwane attorneys' practice that serves clients in person and remotely, with consultations by appointment and support by phone, email or WhatsApp. Its services cover personal injury and RAF claims, family law and maintenance, divorce, estate planning, general and civil litigation, debt collection, defamation claims, corporate and commercial law and bail applications.

The firm says it takes the time to understand each client's circumstances and tailors its approach to the best possible outcome. It serves individuals and families, including those who need a community trust attorney or guidance on complex litigation. Walk-in appointments are available at its Jorissen Street office in Polokwane.

items.description:
Bougain Villa Guest House offers both guest-house rooms and self-catering accommodation in Fauna Park, with four en-suite rooms and two fully self-catering flats set around gardens with a swimming pool and braai and lapa facilities. Guests have access to Wi-Fi and Netflix in their rooms.

The property's own information places it about 400 metres from Savannah Shopping Centre, a kilometre from Pholoso Hospital and three kilometres from Peter Mokaba Stadium, making it a convenient base for visitors exploring Polokwane. It suits leisure guests looking for a relaxed getaway, couples wanting privacy, and business travellers needing a quiet place to stay close to the city's amenities.

Galito's City Centre serves flame-grilled peri-peri chicken in flavours ranging from BBQ and Lemon & Herb through to Mild, Hot and Extra Hot Peri-Peri, paired with chips and a range of other sides. The chain is known across South Africa for its flame-grilling method and range of spice levels to suit different tastes.

This branch trades from Shop 28 in City Centre Mall on Bok Street in Polokwane, offering dine-in seating, takeaway counters and delivery for diners who would rather eat at home. It is open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 7pm and Sunday from 9am to 5pm, making it a reliable option for individual diners, families and groups ordering in.

Operating from the Sasol filling station on Nelson Mandela Drive in the Madiba Park area of Seshego, this Galito's branch specialises in flame-grilled peri-peri chicken served in BBQ, Lemon & Herb, Mild, Hot and Extra Hot flavours, along with chips and other sides. Being based at a service station gives it longer trading hours than many sit-down branches, with the branch's own information listing hours that extend to midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.

Dine-in, takeaway and delivery are all available, and customers can also order online. It is a convenient stop for individuals and families travelling along Nelson Mandela Drive, as well as for anyone wanting a late-night peri-peri chicken order over the weekend.

items.description:
Masamah Graphics offers graphic design, printing, website design and development, and photo and video editing from a stall at the Mankweng Business Centre Complex. Its graphic design work includes logos, posters, banners, calendars, book covers, business cards, clothing designs and illustration.

The business also prints paper products and designs and develops websites, covering page architecture, content creation and graphic design. Its photo and video editing is prepared for use on social media, websites and printed materials, and it also creates photo and video adverts to help clients promote their businesses. The business says it offers paper printing for now and plans to expand its printing to a larger scale.

items.description:
PEPPS Ga-Ledwaba Primary School is an independent, co-educational primary school in Lebowakgomo that is registered with the Limpopo Department of Education, accredited by the Independent Schools Association of Southern Africa, and follows the CAPS curriculum. Its teaching focuses on 21st-century learning skills, including inventive thinking, effective communication, productivity and self-discipline, alongside ethical decision-making.

The school also builds multicultural learning and environmental awareness into school life, and is recognised as an Eco-School, with learners taking part in recycling, sustainability projects and community awareness activities. It serves primary school learners from Lebowakgomo and the surrounding area, offering a rounded education that extends beyond the standard classroom curriculum.

Phoenix Industrial & Safety Supplies manufactures and supplies industrial and occupational safety products, with a focus on affordable, durable solutions for high-risk working environments. The company was established in 1993, originally supplying cleaning rags before expanding its range into the wider industrial and safety products it offers today.

It has since grown into a company with a workforce of more than 180 people, supplying high-risk industries and businesses that need reliable protective and safety equipment for their operations. The company's Polokwane branch, in Superbia, forms part of that national supply network, giving local businesses access to the same product range and service.

Pietersburg Lodge is a hotel in the Ivy Park suburb of Polokwane, with 48 luxurious rooms. The rooms are air-conditioned and have satellite television, and the lodge is about 3 km from the Peter Mokaba Stadium.

The lodge has a restaurant and a pub, and it offers a braai area and conference facilities. Its website describes comfort and hospitality, with luxurious rooms, modern conference spaces and delectable dining, and it lists local attractions for guests to visit. Rooms are priced from R1,200 a night for two people sharing, and bookings can be made through its website or by phone and email. The lodge is at 4 Pringle Street.

PNA Mall of the North stocks a wide range of stationery and arts-and-crafts products, covering school, office, creative and book-related items for shoppers of all ages. The branch's presence in Mall of the North is confirmed independently through the centre's own directory, alongside PNA's official store locator, which lists this branch within its network.

The store serves school learners, students, families, artists, office workers and anyone needing everyday stationery supplies, making it a regular stop for back-to-school shopping as well as ongoing office and craft needs. It trades from Shop L13 within Mall of the North on Munnik Avenue in Bendor, offering a convenient stop for stationery, book and craft shopping while visiting the centre.

Sidze Guest House is a guesthouse in the heart of Polokwane, offering luxurious accommodation for business and leisure travellers. Its suites include a standard suite, a deluxe suite, a deluxe long-stay suite and an exquisite option, each with air conditioning, a large television with DStv, and tea and coffee facilities.

The guesthouse serves nutritious, flavourful meals, and guests can reach the city's major shopping malls and attractions nearby. The website describes the stay as a sanctuary of comfort and calm. Standard suites are priced from R750 a night and deluxe suites from R850 a night, and the guesthouse is at 82 Johnson Street, Polokwane Extension 4.

items.description:
Cashbuild Baobab Gardens is a branch of the Cashbuild building-materials chain, trading as part of the wider Baobab Gardens retail hub built up around what Cashbuild's own current store directory describes as the Cashbuild Retail Centre. It stocks the same broad range of building materials, timber, cement, hardware and related supplies found at Cashbuild stores across the region.

The branch serves homeowners planning renovations, DIY customers tackling their own projects, and builders and other construction trades needing supplies for bigger jobs. It is located on Veldspaat Street in Polokwane, within a retail precinct that has grown specifically around the Cashbuild store, making it a straightforward stop for a full building-materials run.

Fairplay Hardware stocks a broad range of building materials and hardware, including paint, plumbing and electrical supplies, cement, boards, doors, steel and fencing, roofing sheets, aluminium windows, tiles, sanitaryware, lighting and tools, as well as timber for building and renovation projects. The branch is confirmed as an active, trading part of the wider Fairplay Hardware network.

It serves homeowners, DIY customers, builders and contractors across the areas the Fairplay network covers, stocking enough of a range to cover both small household repairs and larger construction jobs. The store trades from Stand 23 BA on Mohlala Road, behind Mall@Lebo in Lebowakgomo, giving local customers a nearby source for hardware and building supplies without having to travel further into Polokwane.

The practice is an optometry clinic at the Cycad Centre in Bendor, Polokwane, offering comprehensive eye exams, contact lens fitting and designer eyewear. It says it has served Bendor for more than a decade and uses state-of-the-art technology and equipment to provide tailored eye care.

The clinic's services include general eye exams, eye disease diagnosis for conditions such as glaucoma, cataracts and diabetic retinopathy, and spectacle lens advice and enhancements. Its frame range runs from affordable everyday options to designer brands such as Ray-Ban, Oakley, Gucci and Tom Ford. A two-for-one promotion on eye exams is advertised, and visitors can book online.

Maizey Plastics Polokwane is a branch of a family-owned plastics supplier with a history stretching back to 1950. The branch distributes signage and engineering plastics to the signage, marine, agriculture, engineering and architecture industries.

Its signage range includes acrylic sheets, polycarbonate, pigmented vinyl, heat transfer films, foam boards, ACM, ABS and Correx, as well as aluminium lightbox and LED profiles and channel letters. The business says it offers personalised service, integrity and customer satisfaction, and it has been a trusted supplier of quality products for more than 75 years. The company says it works across industries and specialises in the distribution of signage and engineering materials, with a range chosen to suit the needs of each sector. Its website highlights a comprehensive range of quality products, and the branch serves its customers from Superbia, Polokwane.

items.description:
Thomsons Body 107 is a panel beating and spray painting business with more than 30 years of experience in auto body repair. Its services cover accident damage, insurance repairs, chassis repair and a fresh new look for a vehicle.

The business says it restores vehicles to their original condition, in both appearance and performance, and that its work meets manufacturer standards. It is approved by insurance companies and vehicle manufacturers, and it lists those approvals on its website. The business says it brings vehicles back to life with precision, care and craftsmanship, and that its team has the skills and technology to get customers back on the road safely. The workshop is in Superbia, Polokwane.

items.description:
A H Burger Attorney Incorporated is a Fauna Park law practice offering civil, commercial and High Court litigation alongside the drafting of contracts, wills and leases, and the administration of deceased estates. Its practice also covers commercial drafting, consumer and credit matters and curatorship work, together with general legal advice across a broad range of everyday legal needs.

The practice opened its doors on 1 May 2017 and takes instructions from private clients and companies as well as from other attorneys and correspondent firms around the country, acting as local counsel for matters that need representation in Polokwane. It is based at Rendezvous Flats, on the corner of Thabo Mbeki and Nyala Streets in Fauna Park.

Auto Supreme provides vehicle care services including car washing, auto detailing, valet services and professional auto-body repairs, giving customers a single outlet for both routine cleaning and more involved bodywork. Auto Supreme Group's own information describes the business as an Auto Care franchise and lists Polokwane as the group's headquarters.

Customers can order coffee and light meals on site while their vehicle is being washed or detailed, making a visit less of a wait and more of a short break. The branch trades from the corner of Munnik Avenue and School Road at The Farmyard Trading Post in Bendor, serving vehicle owners who want their car cleaned, detailed or repaired without having to go elsewhere for additional work.

items.description:
Hyundai Polokwane is a Hyundai vehicle dealership operating from the Polokwane Import Multifranchise complex on Tagore Street in Nirvana. Current Motus dealer listings confirm it as part of the group's network of franchised dealerships across the country.

The dealership serves customers in the market for a new or used Hyundai, along with the dealership services that typically go alongside a vehicle purchase, such as finance arrangements, trade-ins and after-sales support. Its position within the wider Import Multifranchise complex means Hyundai buyers in Polokwane have a dedicated dealership to deal with, rather than a shared showroom covering multiple unrelated brands, giving the Hyundai brand its own consistent, dealership-backed presence in the city.

New and used Kia passenger cars and commercial vehicles are sold through Kia Polokwane, the brand's dealership on Tagore Street in Nirvana. The dealership appears in Motus's current dealer listings as one of its franchised outlets, giving it the backing of the wider Motus dealer network.

Buyers can deal directly with the dealership for sales, and typical related services such as finance, trade-ins and ongoing vehicle support are available alongside a purchase. The dealership shares the Polokwane Import Multifranchise complex with its neighbouring Hyundai dealership, but operates as its own Kia-branded outlet within that site, giving customers shopping specifically for a Kia a dedicated point of contact.

Mr Price Mall of the North is a branch of the Mr Price fashion chain, confirmed both on the retailer's own store page and independently in Mall of the North's own centre directory. The branch carries the chain's usual range of on-trend, affordable clothing and related fashion items for the family.

It serves general fashion shoppers looking for everyday and occasion wear without a high price tag, trading from Shop U62 in Mall of the North on Munnik Avenue in Bendor. The store is open from 9am to 7pm on weekdays, and from 9am to 5pm on weekends and public holidays, fitting around most shopping trips to the centre.

Tambati Overnight and Conference is a bed and breakfast in Penina Park, Polokwane, offering affordable yet luxurious overnight accommodation with 17 fully furnished rooms. The property has lush gardens, a sparkling pool, a children's play area and recreation areas, and it is set just outside the noise of the city.

Its bed and breakfast suits business travellers, backpackers, tourists and holidaymakers, and guests can book single, double, twin and luxury rooms. The property offers ample parking and security, and its website describes a warm and inviting atmosphere with efficient service. Tambati also has a fully featured conference facility for meetings and events.

Orchid Aesthetics is an aesthetic clinic in Sterpark, Polokwane, offering botox and tissue fillers for ageing skin and facial rejuvenation. Its treatments also include anti-ageing solutions, acne treatment, chemical peels, cellulite treatment, medical weight loss, detox programmes and vitamin drips for IV hydration.

The clinic lists prices for some treatments on its website, including crow's feet at R2,100, brow lifts from R1,400 and nasolabial lifts from R2,800. Patients are asked to book an appointment by phone or email, or through the online portal. The clinic presents several of its treatments as non-surgical options for people who want to feel good about their appearance.
